## Crescent Biopharma to Present at September Investor Conferences


September 3, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.crescentbiopharma.com/node/10426/pdf)


WALTHAM, Mass., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Crescent Biopharma, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rsRnBSVCZ50bClnqbuugUdXjJDKvERj9zjbzrFJXZTEqZHoDuAbVQAn97-DzkL9UXyNKWwF_XxsT1EO6ZYkiMtiSWWWRki2DdLzfsmnqlYaB2jGAoPWoQS9jjFGmFCmV) (“Crescent” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: CBIO), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to rapidly advancing the next wave of therapies for cancer patients, today announced that management is scheduled to present at the following investor conferences in September:


- **2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference,** fireside chat on Thursday, September 10, 2026 at 1:35 p.m. ET in New York.


- **Morgan Stanley 24** **th** **Annual Global Healthcare Conference,** fireside chat on Monday, September 14, 2026 at 5:35 p.m. ET in New York.


A live webcast of each presentation will be available in the Investors section of the Company's website at[https://investors.crescentbiopharma.com/events-presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Qo9HvJkKv46N3Kcw7OtipF_10uAxjFqQjweFZcmSzub8_sRM91bX2SsmTCdwsOxTf3NSxxeGZk9SMURJMpN36W7eB_8ShMrAtt4vqLvPgNPJeQHG2a041MauRe_tkYFhlrjQu5lv7eGQ4a5XYLGwRMHtucLSaRGim3Bc6I5eJgF6u-Ea0OAzWowSraoK5DZaRTuBcpCDpD0IxBcJq3niHA==) , and a replay will be accessible for 90 days.


**About Crescent Biopharma**


Crescent Biopharma’s vision is to build a world leading oncology company bringing the next wave of therapies for cancer patients. The Company’s clinical-stage pipeline includes its lead program, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody, as well as novel antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). By leveraging multiple modalities and established targets, Crescent aims to rapidly advance potentially transformative therapies as single agents and as part of combination regimens to treat a range of solid tumors. For more information, visit[www.crescentbiopharma.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Mv2porxyHdivEKO4PR0xmF9QgjuiliL9jn1Whwco5MbKjPjezr2y9tESDTOmh_AWny4l_ouK-ZXMR7v6pqvH80uX1bd4Ov-fs40uw6UNKd1Yn398WF8c_FbkSfULMXF7) and follow the Company on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4MH9Vhf7974X2toux-XjKkctxw7OHhRbshDvE_G0g1ADZoOtuH1VowfU4flt99uQqvTj9G4GZfVk0sf7QT4Sywu0rSiCCVU5AyF9KRCwrVsLNugLoMIoDRQvuMGaKjMe) and[X](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mvh9A6yHvbOfTv6jU-yrJuEuVHwElz3Ytncdf09jQPEbxS-iBJfXqv6NyO6mrD9PDY9O2XkJ-I7WgjvvtLkvgg==) .
